n191f23964f.headline: A typical plot in a city costs 1.5 million. In Prague four times more - Novinky
n191f23964f.summary: Land prices for building plots in Czech cities average 1.5 million crowns, with Prague prices about four times higher than regional cities.
n191f23964f.why: Real estate prices affect construction activity, housing affordability, and local economic development.
